samples.question: Four pip-labeled lamps start as shown (filled = ON, ring = OFF). Read the eight cards from left to right. A triangular TICKET card adds one pending toggle for the lamp named by its 1-4 pips; it does not change any lamp yet. A circular PULSE card applies every pending toggle, then clears all pending tickets. Two pending toggles for the same lamp cancel. Tickets still pending after card 8 are never applied. After all cards, how many lamps are ON? Answer 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
